title: Action Wake Park

services.name: Wakeboard Club
services.desc: Welcome to the debut of Action’s Rec Wakeboard League! West Michigan finaly has a time and place for the casual wakeboarder to thrive! The RWL rides 5 Wednesday nights at Action Wake Park during the summer. - No pressure to be awesome - Ride with other Adults - Meet other cool people - Socialize afterwords with some cool bev’s (byob) Fall Hours: Monday - Tuesday: Closed Wednesday - Student Nights 3pm-6:30pm Thursday - Friday - 3pm-8pm Saturday: 1pm-8pm Fall Hours: Monday - Tuesday: Closed Wednesday - Student Nights 3pm-6:30pm Thursday - Friday - 3pm-8pm Saturday:

blurb: A full circuit inflatable water park perfect for the whole family and parties. A cable system tows wakeboarding, and kneeboarding in a calm lake with out the need for a boat, bringing the joy of water sports to a whole new audience. With event and party spaces, we promise to deliver you a premium experience!
